description: This script generates a mime types configuration file for lighttpd by reading /etc/mime.types, adding custom mappings, and outputting a configuration block for mime type assignment. It includes handling for conflicts between mime types, default mappings, and comments explaining various features.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Associates a file extension with a MIME type, updating internal mappings.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new extension to MIME type mapping, resolving conflicts and considering case insensitivity.

methods.name: print_type
methods.description: Outputs a line mapping a file extension to its MIME type in the configuration output.
